#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../../.." && pwd)"
AUDIT="${REPO_ROOT}/architectures/seer/wrappers/lrnode/audit_joint_latent_action_surrogate.sh"
TRAIN="${REPO_ROOT}/architectures/seer/wrappers/lrnode/train_joint_latent_action_surrogate.sh"
EVAL="${REPO_ROOT}/architectures/seer/wrappers/lrnode/eval_joint_latent_action_surrogate.sh"
ANALYZE="${REPO_ROOT}/architectures/seer/wrappers/lrnode/analyze_joint_latent_action_surrogate.sh"
CALIBRATE="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/calibrate_joint_surrogate_losses.py"
FREEZE="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/freeze_joint_surrogate_loss_weights.py"
VERIFY="${REPO_ROOT}/tools/seer/verify_joint_latent_action_surrogate_source_lock.py"

cd "${REPO_ROOT}"

CAMPAIGN_TAG="${CAMPAIGN_TAG:-joint_latent_action_surrogate_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)}"
CAMPAIGN_ROOT="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT:-${REPO_ROOT}/results/seer/joint_latent_action_surrogate/${CAMPAIGN_TAG}}"
SOURCE_LOCK_MANIFEST="${SOURCE_LOCK_MANIFEST:-${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/source_lock/source_lock_manifest.json}"
MASTER_PORT_BASE="${MASTER_PORT_BASE:-15000}"
RUN_SECONDARY_K4="${RUN_SECONDARY_K4:-0}"
PREFLIGHT_ONLY="${PREFLIGHT_ONLY:-0}"
REVIEWER="${REVIEWER:-${USER:-unknown}}"

export CAMPAIGN_TAG CAMPAIGN_ROOT SOURCE_LOCK_MANIFEST
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-4,5,6,7}"
export NODE_NUM="${NODE_NUM:-4}"
export REPORT_TO_WANDB="${REPORT_TO_WANDB:-1}"
export SAVE_VIDEO="${SAVE_VIDEO:-0}"
export PYTHONPATH="${REPO_ROOT}:${PYTHONPATH:-}"
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM="${TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM:-false}"
export TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD="${TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD:-1}"
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF="${PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF:-expandable_segments:True}"

export TEACHER_CKPT="${TEACHER_CKPT:-/home/mingyujung/private/seer/seer_node3/runs_lrnode_protocol_20260616/train/scratch/sd1_scratch_baseline_seer_scratch_baseline_v1_20260616_141040/33.pth}"
export CANONICAL_ADAPTER_CKPT="${CANONICAL_ADAPTER_CKPT:-/home/mingyujung/private/seer/seer_node3/runs_lrnode_protocol_20260616/train/distill_node/sd1_distill_node_lrnode_distill_from_scratch_baseline_ckpt33_lronly_v1_lw05_aw01_g4_20260620_202533/39.pth}"
export ACTION_CORRECTION_CKPT="${ACTION_CORRECTION_CKPT:-${REPO_ROOT}/results/seer/latentloop/comparison/q1q2_all_20260809_fix2/train/action_full/checkpoints/sd1_distill_node_matched_action_space_correction_teacher33_full_v1_q1q2_all_20260809_fix2_action_full/microstep_041600.pth}"
export VIT_CHECKPOINT_PATH="${VIT_CHECKPOINT_PATH:-${REPO_ROOT}/architectures/seer/upstream/checkpoints/vit_mae/mae_pretrain_vit_base.pth}"
JOINT_DATASET_ROOT="${JOINT_DATASET_ROOT:-${REPO_ROOT}/architectures/seer/upstream/LIBERO_DATASETS/libero_10_converted}"
if [[ -n "${ROOT_DIR:-}" && "${ROOT_DIR}" != "${JOINT_DATASET_ROOT}" ]]; then
    echo "[CONFIG] ignoring ambient ROOT_DIR=${ROOT_DIR}"
fi
export ROOT_DIR="${JOINT_DATASET_ROOT}"
export DATASET="${DATASET:-libero_10_converted}"
export LIBERO_PATH="${LIBERO_PATH:-/home/mingyujung/private/LIBERO}"
export EPISODE_MANIFEST="${EPISODE_MANIFEST:-${REPO_ROOT}/codex_outputs/seer_horizon_regeneration_intervention_20260814_022442/implementation_source_lock/canonical_episode_manifest.csv}"
export HISTORICAL_SOURCE_LOCK="${HISTORICAL_SOURCE_LOCK:-${REPO_ROOT}/codex_outputs/seer_horizon_regeneration_intervention_20260814_022442/implementation_source_lock/source_lock_manifest.json}"

port() {
    local offset="$1"
    printf '%d\n' "$((MASTER_PORT_BASE + offset))"
}

require_file() {
    local path="$1" label="$2"
    [[ -f "${path}" ]] || { echo "[ERROR] missing ${label}: ${path}" >&2; exit 1; }
}

require_dir() {
    local path="$1" label="$2"
    [[ -d "${path}" ]] || { echo "[ERROR] missing ${label}: ${path}" >&2; exit 1; }
}

require_json_pass() {
    local path="$1" label="$2"
    require_file "${path}" "${label}"
    python -c 'import json,sys; x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); raise SystemExit(0 if x.get("pass") is True else 1)' \
        "${path}" || { echo "[ERROR] ${label} is not PASS: ${path}" >&2; exit 1; }
}

run_train_if_missing() {
    local marker="$1" stage="$2" offset="$3"
    shift 3
    if [[ -s "${marker}" ]]; then
        echo "[SKIP] completed training stage=${stage}: ${marker}"
        return
    fi
    echo "[RUN] training stage=${stage}"
    env STAGE="${stage}" MASTER_PORT="$(port "${offset}")" "$@" bash "${TRAIN}"
    require_file "${marker}" "training completion marker for ${stage}"
}

run_analysis_if_missing() {
    local marker="$1" stage="$2"
    if [[ -s "${marker}" ]]; then
        echo "[SKIP] completed analysis stage=${stage}: ${marker}"
        return
    fi
    echo "[RUN] analysis stage=${stage}"
    env STAGE="${stage}" bash "${ANALYZE}"
    require_file "${marker}" "analysis artifact for ${stage}"
}

make_candidate_if_missing() {
    local stage="$1" raw="$2" candidate="$3"
    if [[ -s "${candidate}" ]]; then
        echo "[SKIP] existing calibration candidate: ${candidate}"
        return
    fi
    require_file "${raw}" "${stage} raw-loss JSONL"
    python "${CALIBRATE}" \
        --raw-jsonl "${raw}" --source-lock "${SOURCE_LOCK_MANIFEST}" \
        --stage "${stage}" --output "${candidate}"
}

review_and_freeze() {
    local stage="$1" candidate="$2" frozen="$3"
    if [[ -s "${frozen}" ]]; then
        echo "[SKIP] existing frozen loss contract: ${frozen}"
        return
    fi
    require_file "${candidate}" "${stage} calibration candidate"
    echo
    echo "[REVIEW] ${stage} raw-loss calibration candidate"
    python -m json.tool "${candidate}"
    echo
    if [[ ! -t 0 ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] interactive loss review requires a foreground terminal/tmux pane" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    local answer
    read -r -p "Type 'FREEZE ${stage}' to predeclare these weights: " answer
    [[ "${answer}" == "FREEZE ${stage}" ]] || {
        echo "[STOP] ${stage} weights were not approved; no subsequent stage was launched."
        exit 2
    }
    python "${FREEZE}" \
        --candidate "${candidate}" --output "${frozen}" --reviewer "${REVIEWER}"
}

for file in "${AUDIT}" "${TRAIN}" "${EVAL}" "${ANALYZE}" "${CALIBRATE}" \
    "${FREEZE}" "${VERIFY}" "${TEACHER_CKPT}" "${CANONICAL_ADAPTER_CKPT}" \
    "${ACTION_CORRECTION_CKPT}" "${VIT_CHECKPOINT_PATH}" "${EPISODE_MANIFEST}" \
    "${HISTORICAL_SOURCE_LOCK}"; do
    require_file "${file}" "required input"
done
require_dir "${ROOT_DIR}/${DATASET}" "training dataset"
require_file "${ROOT_DIR}/${DATASET}/meta_info.h5" "converted dataset metadata"
require_file "${REPO_ROOT}/architectures/seer/upstream/data_info/${DATASET}.json" \
    "Seer dataset index"
require_dir "${LIBERO_PATH}" "LIBERO repository"
[[ "${CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV:-}" == "seer_libero" ]] || {
    echo "[ERROR] activate the seer_libero conda environment before running" >&2
    exit 1
}
command -v torchrun >/dev/null || {
    echo "[ERROR] torchrun is unavailable in the active environment" >&2
    exit 1
}

IFS=',' read -r -a visible_gpus <<< "${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES}"
[[ "${#visible_gpus[@]}" -eq "${NODE_NUM}" ]] || {
    echo "[ERROR] CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES exposes ${#visible_gpus[@]} GPUs but NODE_NUM=${NODE_NUM}" >&2
    exit 1
}
[[ "$((20 % NODE_NUM))" -eq 0 && "$((4 % NODE_NUM))" -eq 0 ]] || {
    echo "[ERROR] fixed episode counts 20 and 4 must be divisible by NODE_NUM=${NODE_NUM}" >&2
    exit 1
}
[[ "${MASTER_PORT_BASE}" -ge 1024 && "$((MASTER_PORT_BASE + 740))" -le 65535 ]] || {
    echo "[ERROR] MASTER_PORT_BASE=${MASTER_PORT_BASE} leaves an invalid port range" >&2
    exit 1
}
[[ "${RUN_SECONDARY_K4}" == "0" || "${RUN_SECONDARY_K4}" == "1" ]] || {
    echo "[ERROR] RUN_SECONDARY_K4 must be 0 or 1" >&2
    exit 1
}

echo "[CONFIG] campaign=${CAMPAIGN_TAG}"
echo "[CONFIG] root=${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}"
echo "[CONFIG] GPUs=${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES} NODE_NUM=${NODE_NUM}"
echo "[CONFIG] primary=K_F8/K_G3, secondary_K4=${RUN_SECONDARY_K4}"
echo "[CONFIG] three reviewed loss freezes are required in this foreground terminal"

if [[ "${PREFLIGHT_ONLY}" == "1" ]]; then
    echo "[PREFLIGHT][OK] environment, files, dataset layout, GPU count, and port bounds are valid"
    exit 0
fi

mkdir -p "${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}"

if [[ -s "${SOURCE_LOCK_MANIFEST}" ]]; then
    python "${VERIFY}" --manifest "${SOURCE_LOCK_MANIFEST}"
else
    bash "${AUDIT}"
fi

STAGE_A_RUN="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/train/calibration_a/checkpoints/calibration_a_${CAMPAIGN_TAG}"
run_train_if_missing \
    "${STAGE_A_RUN}/analysis/training_budget_complete.json" calibration_a 0
STAGE_A_CANDIDATE="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/loss_contracts/stage_a_candidate.json"
STAGE_A_FROZEN="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/loss_contracts/stage_a_frozen.json"
make_candidate_if_missing stage_a \
    "${STAGE_A_RUN}/analysis/joint_raw_losses.jsonl" "${STAGE_A_CANDIDATE}"
review_and_freeze stage_a "${STAGE_A_CANDIDATE}" "${STAGE_A_FROZEN}"
export STAGE_A_WEIGHTS="${STAGE_A_FROZEN}"

STAGE_A_SMOKE="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/train/stage_a_smoke/checkpoints/stage_a_smoke_${CAMPAIGN_TAG}"
STAGE_A_FULL="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/train/stage_a_full/checkpoints/stage_a_full_${CAMPAIGN_TAG}"
run_train_if_missing \
    "${STAGE_A_SMOKE}/analysis/training_budget_complete.json" stage_a_smoke 10 \
    STAGE_A_WEIGHTS="${STAGE_A_WEIGHTS}"
run_train_if_missing \
    "${STAGE_A_FULL}/analysis/training_budget_complete.json" stage_a_full 20 \
    STAGE_A_WEIGHTS="${STAGE_A_WEIGHTS}"
if [[ ! -s "${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/selection/stage_a_selection.json" ]]; then
    env STAGE=stage_a_validate MASTER_PORT="$(port 30)" \
        STAGE_A_WEIGHTS="${STAGE_A_WEIGHTS}" \
        STAGE_A_CHECKPOINT_DIR="${STAGE_A_FULL}" bash "${TRAIN}"
fi
run_analysis_if_missing "${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/offline/stage_a_gates.json" stage_a_gate
require_json_pass "${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/offline/stage_a_gates.json" "Stage-A offline gate"

STAGE_B_CAL="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/train/calibration_b/checkpoints/calibration_b_${CAMPAIGN_TAG}"
run_train_if_missing \
    "${STAGE_B_CAL}/analysis/training_budget_complete.json" calibration_b 40
STAGE_B_CANDIDATE="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/loss_contracts/stage_b_candidate.json"
STAGE_B_FROZEN="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/loss_contracts/stage_b_frozen.json"
make_candidate_if_missing stage_b \
    "${STAGE_B_CAL}/analysis/joint_raw_losses.jsonl" "${STAGE_B_CANDIDATE}"
review_and_freeze stage_b "${STAGE_B_CANDIDATE}" "${STAGE_B_FROZEN}"
export STAGE_B_WEIGHTS="${STAGE_B_FROZEN}"

WIDE_CAL="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/train/calibration_wide/checkpoints/calibration_wide_${CAMPAIGN_TAG}"
run_train_if_missing \
    "${WIDE_CAL}/analysis/training_budget_complete.json" calibration_wide 50
WIDE_CANDIDATE="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/loss_contracts/wide_candidate.json"
WIDE_FROZEN="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/loss_contracts/wide_frozen.json"
make_candidate_if_missing wide \
    "${WIDE_CAL}/analysis/joint_raw_losses.jsonl" "${WIDE_CANDIDATE}"
review_and_freeze wide "${WIDE_CANDIDATE}" "${WIDE_FROZEN}"
export WIDE_WEIGHTS="${WIDE_FROZEN}"

STAGE_B_SMOKE="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/train/stage_b_smoke/checkpoints/stage_b_smoke_${CAMPAIGN_TAG}"
STAGE_B_FULL="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/train/stage_b_full/checkpoints/stage_b_full_${CAMPAIGN_TAG}"
run_train_if_missing \
    "${STAGE_B_SMOKE}/analysis/training_budget_complete.json" stage_b_smoke 60 \
    STAGE_B_WEIGHTS="${STAGE_B_WEIGHTS}" PRETRAINED_LR_SCALE=0.1
run_train_if_missing \
    "${STAGE_B_FULL}/analysis/training_budget_complete.json" stage_b_full 70 \
    STAGE_B_WEIGHTS="${STAGE_B_WEIGHTS}" PRETRAINED_LR_SCALE=0.1
if [[ ! -s "${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/selection/stage_b_selection.json" ]]; then
    env STAGE=stage_b_validate MASTER_PORT="$(port 80)" \
        STAGE_B_WEIGHTS="${STAGE_B_WEIGHTS}" STAGE_B_CHECKPOINT_DIR="${STAGE_B_FULL}" \
        bash "${TRAIN}"
fi

WIDE_SMOKE="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/train/wide_smoke/checkpoints/wide_smoke_${CAMPAIGN_TAG}"
WIDE_FULL="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/train/wide_full/checkpoints/wide_full_${CAMPAIGN_TAG}"
run_train_if_missing \
    "${WIDE_SMOKE}/analysis/training_budget_complete.json" wide_smoke 90 \
    WIDE_WEIGHTS="${WIDE_WEIGHTS}" PRETRAINED_LR_SCALE=0.1
run_train_if_missing \
    "${WIDE_FULL}/analysis/training_budget_complete.json" wide_full 100 \
    WIDE_WEIGHTS="${WIDE_WEIGHTS}" PRETRAINED_LR_SCALE=0.1
if [[ ! -s "${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/selection/wide_selection.json" ]]; then
    env STAGE=wide_validate MASTER_PORT="$(port 110)" \
        WIDE_WEIGHTS="${WIDE_WEIGHTS}" WIDE_CHECKPOINT_DIR="${WIDE_FULL}" \
        bash "${TRAIN}"
fi

run_analysis_if_missing "${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/offline/joint_vs_wide.json" offline_compare
require_json_pass "${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/offline/joint_vs_wide.json" "offline joint/wide comparison"

PARITY_ARTIFACT="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/eval/parity_smoke/k1_endpoint_parity.json"
if [[ ! -s "${PARITY_ARTIFACT}" ]]; then
    env STAGE=parity_smoke MASTER_PORT_BASE="$(port 200)" \
        EPISODES_PER_TASK=4 NUM_TASKS=1 NODE_NUM="${NODE_NUM}" SAVE_VIDEO=0 \
        bash "${EVAL}"
    env STAGE=parity bash "${ANALYZE}"
fi
require_json_pass "${PARITY_ARTIFACT}" "K1/endpoint parity"

FINAL_VERDICT="${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/eval/scientific_k8/aggregate/final_verdict.json"
if [[ ! -s "${FINAL_VERDICT}" ]]; then
    env STAGE=scientific_k8 MASTER_PORT_BASE="$(port 300)" \
        EPISODES_PER_TASK=20 NUM_TASKS=10 NODE_NUM="${NODE_NUM}" \
        SAVE_VIDEO="${SAVE_VIDEO}" bash "${EVAL}"
    if [[ -e "${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/eval/scientific_k8/aggregate" ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] partial aggregate exists without final verdict; audit it before resuming" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    env STAGE=aggregate_k8 BOOTSTRAP_ITERATIONS=10000 BOOTSTRAP_SEED=20260816 \
        bash "${ANALYZE}"
fi
require_file "${FINAL_VERDICT}" "frozen K8 verdict"

if [[ "${RUN_SECONDARY_K4}" == "1" ]]; then
    env ENABLE_SECONDARY_K4=1 STAGE=secondary_k4 MASTER_PORT_BASE="$(port 500)" \
        EPISODES_PER_TASK=20 NUM_TASKS=10 NODE_NUM="${NODE_NUM}" \
        SAVE_VIDEO="${SAVE_VIDEO}" bash "${EVAL}"
fi

date --iso-8601=seconds > "${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}/sequential_run_complete.txt"
echo "[DONE] Joint Latent-Anchored Action Surrogate campaign"
echo "[DONE] verdict=${FINAL_VERDICT}"
echo "[DONE] root=${CAMPAIGN_ROOT}"
